comments.text: public transportation is a different use case, but the frustration is familiar: reliability, routing and handoffs matter more than a pretty system map. Transport S&H deals with freight and ecommerce rather than passengers, yet the same operational basics show up there too. Bad coordination is expensive in any transport network.
